title: Surreal Stone Throne
description: A wooden chair draped in flowing red, blue, and rainbow-colored ribbons sits on a cracked stone platform with golden coins scattered around. Wavy, ribbon-like streams of red, blue, green, and rainbow colors twist and rise into a dark, starry sky, with green vine-like growths emerging from the forms.
